purpose: Template for supplier product links used by TradeFind AI.
rule: Do not label a link as an exact product link unless the URL points to the verified product page on the supplier website.

fields.supplier: Supplier display name, e.g. TLC Direct
fields.price: Observed or supplied price. Use 'Check site' or 'Login / trade price' if unknown.
fields.stock: Observed or supplied stock status. Use 'Check supplier site' if unknown.
fields.url: Supplier URL. Prefer exact product-page URL where available.
